host.structural_note: newsSplit takes ONE full-length host clip, not two. build_ep_v2.py:1284-1288 calls host_clip('v2_host', 0, total) and Short.tsx:408-439 plays it as a single element with NO startFrom. The planned host_hook_clip/host_payoff_clip cannot satisfy this - the host pane is live during every split beat.
host.reference_interpretation: +23ms identical across two independent renders with corr>0.999 = AAC encoder priming (1024 samples @ 44.1kHz), not a HeyGen creative lead, and below the ~45ms audio-ahead perceptual threshold. The 123/234ms leads in lipsync_align.py's docstring were on SHORT SLICED renders (rec: beats), a different path.
procedure: render RAW to v2_host_raw.mp4 (never straight to v2_host.mp4)
|lag| <= 0.045 and corr >= 0.95 -> copy raw to v2_host.mp4, record the number
corr < 0.85 -> not a pure time-shift; re-render, do NOT in-point it
host.why_shifted_copy_not_in_point: build_ep_v2.py:1368 sets spec['host'] from full_host directly and Short.tsx gives the host layer no startFrom. There is NO in-point on the host layer - the only place a correction can live is the file itself. This is how the '@0.00 on a raw HeyGen clip' ban is satisfied here: the file IS the in-point, so v2_host.mp4 must be the shifted or verified-clean copy, never the untouched render.
